create_beit_vision_transformer: create a BEiT Vision Transformer model trunk with configurable image size, patch size, and embedding dimensions
build_attention_with_relative_bias: build a multi-head attention module with optional relative position bias for windowed self-attention
build_patch_embedding_layer: build a patch embedding layer that converts input images into token sequences via 2D convolution
run_forward_with_intermediate_features: run the BEiT forward pass and extract intermediate CLS token features from specified blocks
test_mlp_forward_pass: test the MLP block forward pass with configurable hidden dimensions and dropout rate
